vulnerability.name: Apache WebDAV Upload Remote Shell (randomised PHP/CGI)
vulnerability.author: Tom Shaw
vulnerability.description: Composition module that builds a complete, solvable WebDAV-to-shell chain and randomises how the shell is obtained. It selects the writable, unauthenticated WebDAV collection (apache_webdav_upload) and exactly one execution enabler at random: PHP (webdav_file_upload_php) or CGI (webdav_file_upload_cgi). The attacker PUTs a web shell of the matching kind into the collection and runs commands as the Apache user. Drop this single module into a scenario to get a randomised upload-to-RCE target; it declares no resources of its own.
vulnerability.hint: Unauthenticated WebDAV PUT writes a file that Apache then executes (PHP or CGI): upload a matching web shell to get command execution as www-data.
